CustomField.description: API name of the Prompt Builder Flex template the AI provider invokes. Leave blank to use the default name DocGen_HTML_Body. A prompt template cannot be packaged — its version identifier is generated by the platform — so you create it yourself in Setup > Einstein > Prompt Builder. DocGen does not read this field directly; it is here so your provider class can be configured without editing Apex. See docs/AGENTFORCE_SETUP.md.
CustomField.label: AI Prompt Template
